hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Consider the best cumulative score achievable at each location at the end of each day.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: On each step, arriving at location curr can occur either by remaining at curr from yesterday or by traveling from any other location prev.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Iterate day by day over the duration k, maintaining an array of optimal values for each city.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Evaluates in optimal O(k * n^2) runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(n) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies optimal pattern to achieve O(k * n^2) complexity.
